params._percentages: Initial bucket percentages in basis points (must sum to 10_000).

depositForContractors(uint256).details: Caller must approve this contract for at least `amountUSDC` beforehand.      These funds are NOT distributed to buckets — they stay in the contract.

params.amountUSDC: Amount of USDC to deposit for contractor payments.

distribute(uint256).details: Caller must approve this contract for at least `amountUSDC` beforehand.      The final bucket receives any remainder to avoid dust from integer division.

params.amountUSDC: Amount of USDC to pull and distribute.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params.newBuckets: New bucket addresses (2 to 5 buckets, no zero addresses).
params.newPercentages: New bucket percentages in basis points (must sum to 10_000).

bucketAddresses(uint256).notice: Destination addresses that receive split funds.

bucketPercentages(uint256).notice: Split percentages in basis points (must sum to 10_000).

constructor.notice: Initializes the splitter with token, owner, and initial bucket configuration.

depositForContractors(uint256).notice: Deposits USDC into this contract to fund future contractor payments.

distribute(uint256).notice: Pulls USDC from the caller and distributes it across configured buckets.

getBucketCount().notice: Returns the number of configured buckets.

getBuckets().notice: Returns all bucket addresses and their percentages.

payContractor(address,uint256).notice: Pays a contractor from USDC held by this contract.

updateBucketConfig(address[],uint256[]).notice: Updates the bucket addresses and percentages used for distributions.

usdcToken().notice: USDC token address used for all transfers.
